title: Accommodation
subtitle: Some land was always meant to be returned
roomsIntro: DurgBhumi Resort features beautifully designed accommodations inspired by the heritage, landscapes, and cultural charm of Maharashtra. Each stay offers a peaceful blend of luxury, comfort, and nature surrounded by the majestic Sahyadri landscape.

rooms.name: Wada
rooms.description: Designed in traditional Maharashtrian Wada style. With heritage-inspired architecture, warm earthy finishes, spacious interiors, and cultural detailing, the Wada offers guests a luxurious stay rooted in the charm and grandeur of Maharashtra's timeless courtyard homes.
rooms.extraPersonCharges: Extra adult charges: Age (0-10) no charge, 10 years and above – 3000/- + taxes

rooms.name: Machi (1)
rooms.description: Offering beautiful views of the lake and garden from its private deck. Inspired by the fort-side terraces of the Sahyadris, the room blends heritage charm with modern comfort, creating a peaceful space to relax, unwind, and enjoy the natural beauty of DurgBhumi Resort.
rooms.extraPersonCharges: Extra adult charges: Age (0-10) no charge, 10 years and above – 3000/- + taxes

rooms.name: Machi (2)
rooms.description: A cozy and charming room designed for a peaceful stay at DurgBhumi Resort. With a beautiful veranda overlooking the lotus pond, the room offers a calm setting to relax, unwind, and enjoy quiet moments surrounded by nature.
rooms.extraPersonCharges: Extra adult charges: Age (0-10) no charge, 10 years and above – 3000/- + taxes

rooms.name: Osri
rooms.description: Inspired by the traditional verandah-style spaces of Maharashtrian Wada architecture. Designed with warm interiors, heritage touches, and a calm sit-out feel, these rooms offer guests a comfortable stay.
rooms.extraPersonCharges: Extra adult charges: Age (0-10) no charge, 10 years and above – 3000/- + taxes

rooms.name: Machan
rooms.description: Thoughtfully designed as elevated retreats overlooking the serene lake. Inspired by the idea of a traditional viewing deck, these rooms offer a peaceful stay with beautiful water views, natural surroundings, and a sense of quiet luxury.
rooms.extraPersonCharges: Extra adult charges: Age (0-10) no charge, 10 years and above – 3000/- + taxes
